Plate ~26 cm; burger ~9 cm diameter, a slider-plus size. It has a double thin patty, cheese, pickle, slaw and sauce on a brioche bun. Estimate: bun 60 g (~180 kcal), patties 2×45 g = 90 g (~230 kcal), cheese 15 g (~55 kcal), pickles, slaw and sauce 30 g (~80 kcal). Total about 195 g and ~545 kcal.
